copy.gary: I've been wandering Trinidad parks and I still find something new on most visits, like the bandstand at Kit Carson Park or a walk along the Purgatoire River.
copy.description: Check in at every Trinidad, Colorado park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.
copy.made_for: Trinidad and the Santa Fe Trail

motifs.name: Fishers Peak
motifs.blurb: Fishers Peak, the flat-topped mesa that rises over town, is now the heart of Colorado's Fishers Peak State Park.

motifs.name: The Santa Fe Trail
motifs.blurb: Wagons on the Santa Fe Trail's Mountain Route rolled through Trinidad on their way over Raton Pass.

motifs.name: The Purgatoire River
motifs.blurb: The Purgatoire River runs right through town, and the Riverwalk follows it for walkers, joggers and cyclists.

motifs.name: Kit Carson bandstand
motifs.blurb: Kit Carson Park, named for the frontiersman, has a playground, picnic tables and a historic bandstand.

motifs.name: The skate park
motifs.blurb: Trinidad's 14,000-square-foot skate park was ranked ninth in the world by Tony Hawk when it opened in 2003.

motifs.name: Brick streets
motifs.blurb: Many of downtown Trinidad's streets are still paved with bricks made right here in town.
